place: Bang Rak, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Nine-Bedroom Sunset Sea-View Villa above Bang Rak Bay, Walking Distance to the Beach
blurb: A newly completed three-level villa looking west over Bang Rak Bay — a vast open living floor onto an infinity pool, a six-bedroom main house plus a separate three-bedroom apartment, and the beach about 450 metres away on foot.
detail:
Few houses on Koh Samui combine a view like this with a walk to the sand. The villa sits above Bang Rak Bay, facing west over the moored boats and the hills of the north coast, so the main living floor catches every sunset — and the beach, with its restaurants and bars, is roughly 450 metres away. The airport is about two minutes by car and Fisherman’s Village around five.

The main level is one wide, open space: a living area with deep sofas, a sleek western kitchen with bar seating, and two long dining tables carved from solid teak. Full-height glass slides back to a broad terrace and a 10 × 4 metre infinity pool, with a sun deck at the edge and the bay laid out below — it is the obvious place for long dinners as the light goes.

The top floor holds four en-suite bedrooms, three of them with sea views, together with a home office that has one of the best outlooks in the house. Two further bedrooms are on the ground floor alongside a large laundry and storage. Also on the ground floor, connected to the four-car garage but with its own entrance, is a self-contained three-bedroom apartment — ideal for staff, family, or to rent out separately while the main villa is let.

Completed in 2025 to a high standard of construction, the house has mains electricity, generous parking and a pool table for downtime. With around 864 m² of interior space, roughly 1,440 m² of total living area and an 853 m² plot, it works equally well as a large family home or as a flexible investment. Offered freehold through a company structure.
